_comment: Offline fixture documenting the REAL response shape of the GraphQL deep-pagination endpoint used by discoverLive() (src/adapters/jawa_pos/index.js fetchGraphqlArticlesPage) — verified live 2026-07-24 via a direct POST to https://api.jawapos.com/api-jp-graphql with query `articles(filter: { publisherId: "1" }, first: 20, page: 2) { paginatorInfo { hasMorePages } data { article_id title slug description published_at category { name slug } } } }`. Titles/slugs below are entirely fictional placeholder text; only the JSON SHAPE mirrors the real, live-verified response (an `ArticleSimplePaginator`: `{ paginatorInfo: { hasMorePages }, data: Article[] }` — the identical shape `initialArticles`/`categoryArticle` use in __NEXT_DATA__, see index.js header). Not wired into the offline smoke test (which never performs network I/O), kept here as a contract-test/documentation fixture per the Sprint 4 task brief ('listing/GraphQL fixture as needed').
